description: MCV2's reference search (the ship profile) with one feature turned off at a time, against the full encoder, on the two sources of codec_curves.json. Each curve is six lambdas; every point is one tools/mcv2/rate_quality.py encode with tools/mcv2/Mcv2Bench.java, scored with libvmaf the way codec_curves.json scores MCV2. tools/mcv2/figures/charts.py computes the BD-rate of every curve against the baseline on zlib_mbps, the rate after Minecraft's packet compression.
method: A feature was turned off with a switch in a scratch copy of the encoder that is not part of MCAV (BlockCoder.tries for the leaf modes, the local motion branch of BlockCoder.evaluate, the half-pixel steps of FrameJob and BlockCoder, the global vector of Mcv2Encoder.encode, the split decision of Mcv2Encoder.select, and FrameWriter.Options for the writer's forms), or with Mcv2Bench's own argument key. With nothing turned off, the scratch encoder writes the same bytes as MCAV's. The writer-only features (w-*) leave every picture as it is and change only the bytes.
command: python3 tools/mcv2/rate_quality.py --classpath CLASSPATH --main Mcv2Bench --source SRC --frames N --fps 30 --lambdas LAMBDAS --ffmpeg FFMPEG --out OUT -- profile=ship threads=12 budget=true verify=false [key=1]; proxy30: N=30, LAMBDAS=19.0449229,33.670698488,65.255994022,137.730758207,254.48409453,500; gameplay30: N=60, LAMBDAS=30,65.255994022,137.730758207,260,400,900; FFMPEG is ffmpeg 7.0.2 with libvmaf

gameplay30.what: Xiph MINECRAFT.y4m, frames 120-239, every second one: 60 frames at 30 fps

features.name: Global motion
features.what: the global vector is always zero

features.name: Local motion
features.what: no MOTION leaves, and every residual predicts at the global vector

features.name: Half-pixel motion
features.what: local motion in whole pixels only

features.name: Patterns
features.what: no PATTERN candidates (mode 18), and no palette rewritten as a pattern

features.name: Endpoint and selector tables
features.what: the writer writes no endpoint or selector table (flags 512-8192)

features.name: Packed symbols
features.what: the writer writes one byte per descriptor (no flag 64)

features.name: Two-level walk
features.what: the writer writes every walk checkpoint as a u16 pair (no flag 128)

features.name: Derived offsets
features.what: the writer writes the stored-index form (no flag 32, so no flags 64-8192 either)
